name: R no Houkago ~Magyaku Rape Hen~
original_name: Rの放課後 ～魔虐レイプ篇～
source:
After school rape card game series now features fantasy elements. The targets for hard rape are sister Himeno, busty glasses girl Nozomi and mother-in-law Chizuru.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
